# Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) Policy Document

## 1. Executive Summary
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government funded healthcare assurance scheme, providing a health cover of Rs 5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 Crore poor and vulnerable families.

## 2. Coverage & Benefit Package
- Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services for the beneficiary at the point of service (in empanelled hospitals).
- Cover includes 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses such as diagnostics and medicines.
- No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
- All pre-existing conditions are covered from day one.
- Benefits of the scheme are portable across the country (a beneficiary can visit any empanelled public or private hospital in India).

## 3. Beneficiary Identification & Eligibility Criteria
- Identified based on the deprivation and occupational criteria of Socio-Economic and Caste Census 2011 (SECC 2011) for rural and urban areas respectively.

- Identified based on the deprivation and occupational criteria of Socio-Economic and Caste Census 2011 (SECC 2011) for rural and urban areas respectively.
- Rural Criteria: Households living in one room with kucha walls/roof, female-headed households with no adult male member aged 16-59, disabled members, SC/ST households, landless manual casual labor.
- Urban Criteria: 11 defined occupational categories (ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, transport workers, construction workers, etc.).

## 4. Hospital Network & Empanelled Procedures
- Covers approximately 1,949 treatment procedures across 27 specialties including oncology, neurosurgery, cardiology, and orthopaedics.
- Over 29,000 public and private hospitals empanelled nationwide.
- Digital Golden Card issuance via Ayushman Mitra helpdesks at hospital premises.

## 5. Contact Information & Support
- Toll-Free National Helpline: 14555 / 1800-111-565
- Grievance Portal: https://grievance.pmjay.gov.in

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-U / PMAY-G) Operational Guidelines

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) Housing Guidelines

1. Mission Objective

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana addresses urban and rural housing shortages among Economically Weaker Sections (EWS), Low Income Groups (LIG), and rural homeless households by ensuring a pucca house with basic amenities to all eligible families.

2. Eligibility Criteria

The beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

Economically Weaker Section (EWS) annual household income up to Rs 3,00,000.

Low Income Group (LIG) annual household income between Rs 3,00,001 and Rs 6,00,000.

Middle Income Group (MIG-I & MIG-II) income bands as notified by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

3. Subsidy and Financial Assistance

4. Mandatory House Features

# Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Operational Guidelines

## 1. Scheme Overview
The PM-KISAN scheme is a Central Sector Scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families across the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.

## 2. Eligibility & Entitlements
- Under the Scheme, an amount of Rs 6,000/- per year is released in three 4-monthly installments of Rs 2,000/- each directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
- All landholding farmer families who have cultivable landholding in their names are eligible to get benefits under the scheme.
- State Government and UT administration will identify the farmer families which are eligible for support as per scheme guidelines.

## 3. Exclusion Categories
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not be eligible for benefit under the scheme:
- All Institutional Landholders.
- Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to the following categories:
- Former and present holders of constitutional posts.
- Former and present Ministers, State Ministers, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, Chairpersons of District Panchayats
